info.title: School Portal Database Integration Contract
info.description: Required contract for the corrected frontend workflows. Existing client routes are not evidence of deployed backend support. Implement server-side persistence, authorization, transactions and validation before rollout. Non-login assessment and invoice contracts aligned with FRONTEND_REMEDIATION_HANDOFF.md on 2 October 2026. Login and PIN flows remain unchanged. Backend migration a1c2e3f4b5d6 and deployment must be verified separately; synthetic frontend tests do not prove live database persistence. Bulk billing is disabled until approved fee structures and a server preview are available.

x-student-billing-remediation.studentIdentity: One application -> one student UUID -> one linked login account. Name and email appear on the same student record.
x-student-billing-remediation.onboardingBilling: No automatic preset charges. Zero initial billed amount must remain zero.
x-student-billing-remediation.billConsistency: POST /finance/bills/student, GET /finance/fees and student ledger must share canonical invoice identity and exact decimal amounts. Honor stable Idempotency-Key.
x-student-billing-remediation.existingDuplicates: Require a reviewed, transactional merge preserving financial and academic dependencies; no name-only automatic deletion.
x-student-billing-remediation.verification: Frontend synthetic tests only. Backend and production reconciliation pending.

x-pv-provider-remediation.workflow: Saved provider UUID -> canonical server voucher -> head-admin whole-voucher pre-audit and approval -> sub-admin database refresh.
x-pv-provider-remediation.backendDependencies: Verify sub-admin permissions and idempotency enforcement. Separate line-item decisions are not supported by the current published create/read schema.
x-pv-provider-remediation.validation: Synthetic UI tests; no live financial writes.
